F1.name: US vs THEM / comparison
F1.definition: Two sides opposed: rival product or habit vs us; table, check/cross list, 'guess who's on', same person twice as rival-vs-us.
cues: I use X / I use Y

F2.name: Before-after / timeline
F2.definition: The same body or object at two or more moments: day 0 / week 2 / week 4; silhouettes, photos, clay figures; 'bye-bye X'.

F3.name: Problem reframe (X is not the problem)
F3.definition: 'X is not the problem, Y is': the symptom re-labelled onto the mechanism; the sentence carries the idea.

F4.name: Mechanism / anatomy / ingredients
F4.definition: The mechanism made visible: anatomical cut, thermal/x-ray, ingredients inside the capsule, product puzzle, symptom checklist on a body.

F5.name: Origin / ranch / real food
F5.definition: Where it comes from: wild vs farmed as origin story, the ranch, real food on a table, 'what's inside' as sourcing, 'the full system'.

F6.name: Offer / bundle / price
F6.definition: The offer itself: special deal, last call, bundle chooser, challenge with guarantee, 'how many should you buy', 'selling out'.

F7.name: Bold claim + hero product
F7.definition: One frontal promise + the product as hero: 'over 40?', 'zero waste', 'do not take this without warning your wife', hand holding the product + one stat, signed review on product background.

F8.name: Meme / humor / UGC
F8.definition: Meme (wojak/chad, Barbie/Ken, starter pack, 'said no wife ever'), humour, UGC (TikTok captions, selfie day 0/day 90, unboxing, phone screenshot).

F9.name: Off-avatar, re-skin last
F9.definition: Templates from another niche or another avatar; usable only after a full re-skin, adapted last.

NH.name: Negative hook (tone, not a family)
NH.definition: 'DON'T try this', 'We're sorry', 'Zero stars', 'WARNING', crossed-out list. Not one of the 9: sort by the picture (F7 / F3 / F8 / F2). Folder kept only for an ad the tree cannot place.
